parameters.description: WinProp_Antenna: Enabled, Id, SiteId, Longitude_X, Latitude_Y, Height, Power (dBm), Frequency (MHz), Model (WINPROP_MODEL_FREESPACE/COST231/DPM/IRT/SRT/VRT/SBR/MOTLEYKEENAN), DataType (PROP_RESULT_POWER/FIELD/PATHLOSS), Pattern, Azimuth, Downtilt, Name.

parameters.name: DataArea
parameters.description: WinProp_Area: LowerLeftX/Y, UpperRightX/Y, Resolution, NrHeights, Heights.

parameters.name: DataReceiver / NrReceiver
parameters.description: Optional receiving points at repeater antennas (NULL, 0 if not used).

parameters.name: DataModelSettings
parameters.description: Optional Model_DPM, Model_COST, Model_RAYTRACING, ... struct; NULL uses the defaults.

parameters.name: Additional
parameters.description: WinProp_Additional, for example OutputResults (WinProp_Propagation_Results: ResultPath, FieldStrength, PathLoss, DelaySpread, StatusLOS, RayFilePropPaths, StrFilePropPaths ...) and ResultFiltering.

parameters.name: Outputs
parameters.description: DataCoverageOut, DataDelayOut, DataNatureOfPathOut, DataRaysOut, PlanesResultOut, PlanesRaysOut (pass NULL for outputs you do not need).

tools.notes: Declared in source/Interface/Engine.h. Result values below -1000 mark pixels that were not computed (as in the example write_ascii loop). Free outputs with WinProp_FreeResult / WinProp_FreeRayMatrix. Related functions: WinProp_Coverage_Analysis, WinProp_Result_GetAngles, WinProp_Calibrate_DPM. Verified in the installed 2026.1 headers (Engine.h, WP_Defines.h) and the indoor_propagation example.

tools.name: WinProp_Structure_Init_* (API)
tools.description: A family of about 60 functions that fill a WinProp API struct with reasonable default values. Call the matching Init function before you set individual fields, otherwise uninitialised members cause undefined behaviour. Matching WinProp_Structure_Free_* functions release memory allocated inside structs, for example results, polygons, trajectories and model settings.
tools.usage:
int WinProp_Structure_Init_<Name>(<Struct> *ToInit);   e.g. WinProp_Structure_Init_Antenna(WinProp_Antenna*)
int WinProp_Structure_Free_<Name>(<Struct>*);                e.g. WinProp_Structure_Free_Result(WinProp_Result*)

parameters.name: Scenario / Callback / Area / Antenna / Pattern / Additional / Propagation_Results
parameters.description: Core structs for WinProp_Open and WinProp_Predict.

parameters.name: ParameterMain / ParameterRural / ParameterHybrid
parameters.description: WinProp_ParaMain, WinProp_ParaRural and WinProp_ParaHybrid for OutdoorPlugIn_ComputePrediction.

parameters.name: Model_COST / Model_DPM / Model_FREESPACE / Model_MOTLEYKEENAN / Model_RayTracing / Model_UrbanIRT / Model_UrbanITU1411 / Model_VRT
parameters.description: Indoor and urban model settings.

parameters.name: Model_RuralPE / Model_RuralITM / Model_RuralITU1546 / Model_RuralITU526
parameters.description: Rural model settings.

parameters.name: PrePro / PreProUrban / Converter / Carrier / Result / RayMatrix / Trajectory / Receiver / MS_Para
parameters.description: Pre-processing, conversion, network and result structs.

tools.notes: Declared across source/Interface (Init.h, Free.h and the WP_*.h struct headers). The API doc group 'Functions for Initialisation of Structures' lists 58 Init functions. Verified in the installed 2026.1 headers and help (api_auto_generated).

tools.name: OutdoorPlugIn_ComputePrediction (API)
tools.description: The all-in-one outdoor (urban or rural) prediction call: you pass the antenna and all scenario, database and model parameters in one go instead of using WinProp_Open. WinProp_ParaMain selects urban or rural mode, the urban or rural model, and how buildings, topography and clutter are loaded (from files or from memory). It fills a result matrix, optional ray matrix and LOS matrix, and plane results.
tools.usage: int OutdoorPlugIn_ComputePrediction(const WinProp_Antenna *ParameterAntenna, WinProp_ParaMain *ParameterUrban, const WinProp_Receiver *receivingPoints, const int nrReceivingPoints, const void *ParameterModelUrban, WinProp_Measurement *ParameterMeasurements, const WinProp_ParaRural *ParameterRural, const WinProp_ParaHybrid *ParameterCNP, const WinProp_Callback *Callback, WinProp_Result *Resultmatrix, WinProp_RayMatrix *DataRaysOut, WinProp_Result *LOSmatrix, WinProp_ResultPlaneList *ResultPlanes = nullptr, WinProp_RayMatrixList *ResultRayMatrix = nullptr);

parameters.name: ParameterUrban (WinProp_ParaMain)
parameters.description: ScenarioMode (SCENARIOMODE_URBAN / SCENARIOMODE_RURAL), PredictionModelUrban (PREDMODEL_COST/UDP/IRT/KE/ITU1411), PredictionModelRural (PREDMODEL_RURAL_HATA/2RAY_EMP/2RAY_DET/RDP/PE/ITU1546/ITU526/ITM), Urban/Rural LowerLeft/UpperRight, Resolution, NrLayers, PredictionHeights, BuildingsMode, BuildingsName, TopographyMode, ClutterMode, OutputResults.

parameters.name: BuildingsMode
parameters.description: BUILDINGSMODE_NONE, _RAM, _UDP (.opb), _IRT (.oib), _COST (.ocb), _BINARY (.odb), _ASCII (.oda).

parameters.name: ParameterRural / ParameterCNP
parameters.description: Optional WinProp_ParaRural and WinProp_ParaHybrid (hybrid urban/indoor).

parameters.name: Resultmatrix / DataRaysOut / LOSmatrix
parameters.description: Output structs (initialise them first).

tools.notes: Declared in source/Interface/OutdoorPlugIn.h with enums in OutdoorPlugIn_Defines.h. Pass the database name without extension; the example loads City.opb. On error, the message is in ParameterUrban->ErrorMessageMain. InterfaceLoadTopoASC / InterfaceLoadClutterASC (Engine.h) load ASCII grid topography and clutter into ParaMain for TOPOMODE_RAM / CLUTTERMODE_RAM. Related: OutdoorPlugIn_ComputePoints, OutdoorPlugIn_ComputeTrajectories. Verified in the installed 2026.1 headers and the outdoor/rural examples.

tools.name: WinProp_Net_* network planning functions (API)
tools.description: The network planning API in Net/Net.h. You open a network project from an air-interface type or a .wst file, set parameters, add one propagation map per transmitter (from WinProp_Predict), compute, then query network result maps by result type. Further functions manage carriers, transmission modes (MCS), applications and clutter links, points and trajectories, priority maps and Monte Carlo statistics.

parameters.name: NET_PARA_*
parameters.description: Project parameters from Public/AirInterfaces/AI_Define.h, for example NET_PARA_RESOLUTION, NET_PARA_AREA_MODE, NET_PARA_OUTPUT_WINPROP, NET_PARA_HEIGHT_MULTIPLE, NET_PARA_PROJECTNAME, NET_PARA_CARRIERS, NET_PARA_CARRIER_INDEX, NET_PARA_CARRIER_FREQ_DL.

parameters.name: NET_RESULT_*
parameters.description: Result types for NetworkMap_Get, for example NET_RESULT_BEST_SERVER, NET_RESULT_SNIR, NET_RESULT_MAX_THROUGHPUT, NET_RESULT_LTE_RSRP, NET_RESULT_MIMO_NUMBER_STREAMS, NET_RESULT_COVERAGE_PROB.

parameters.name: Other functions
parameters.description: WinProp_Net_Project_Open, _Project_ComputePoints, _Project_ComputeTrajectories, _Carrier_Add/_Para_Get/_Para_Set, _TransmissionMode_Add, _Application_Add, _NetworkMap_Carrier_Get, _NetworkPlane_Get, _NetworkMonteCarloStats_Get, _LosMap_Add, _RayMatrix_Add, _PrioMap_Set.

tools.notes: Link EngineNet.lib. The Service argument -1 is taken from the installed network_planning example. Propagation maps must match the carrier frequencies of the air interface; the example reads them with WinProp_Net_Carrier_Para_Get(..., NET_PARA_CARRIER_FREQ_DL, ...). Further examples: network_planning_parallel, network_planning_5g_tdd, monte_carlo_5g. Verified in the installed 2026.1 Net.h, AI_Define.h, WP_Defines.h and examples.

tools.name: WinProp_Convert (API)
tools.description: Converts external geometry and map databases into WinProp formats, for example .oda to .odb, AutoCAD, STL, IFC, glTF or OpenDRIVE to .idb, or GeoTIFF/ASC to topography and clutter. The WinProp_Converter struct holds the numeric ConverterID, source and destination names, measurement unit, ignored AutoCAD layers and ASCII/binary output. These are the same codes WinPropCLI accepts with --db-format.
tools.usage:
int WinProp_Convert(WinProp_Converter *callConverter, WinProp_Callback *callback);
int WinProp_Structure_Init_Converter(WinProp_Converter*);

parameters.name: ConverterID
parameters.description: 1-20 topography, 101-113 clutter, 201-218 urban (201 .oda, 202 .vda, 205 .shp, 206 .dwg/.dxf, 216 .osm, 217 .odb to .idb, 218 CityGML), 301-319 indoor (301 .ida, 302 .dwg/.dxf, 303-305 .stl, 306 .nas, 307 .obj, 310 .ifc, 315 glTF, 317 .idb to .odb, 319 .xodr).

parameters.name: databaseNameSource
parameters.description: Source file including its extension.

parameters.name: databaseNameDest
parameters.description: Destination name without extension.

parameters.name: measurementUnit / ignoreList
parameters.description: Unit of the source (indoor only, for example "Meter") and AutoCAD layers to skip (indoor only).

parameters.name: SaveAsciiFormat
parameters.description: 0 writes binary output (.odb/.idb), non-zero writes ASCII.

tools.name: WinProp_PreProcessIndoor / OutdoorPlugIn_ComputePrePro (API)
tools.description: API equivalents of WallMan pre-processing for intelligent ray tracing. WinProp_PreProcessIndoor pre-processes an indoor vector database (.ida/.idb) into an IRT database, with optional time-variant steps. OutdoorPlugIn_ComputePrePro pre-processes an urban database, from files or from in-memory buildings and topography, for IRT, COST or UDP according to WinProp_PreProUrban.

int WinProp_PreProcessIndoor(const char *SourceVectordatabase, const char *DestinationVectordatabase, const WinProp_PrePro *Para, const WinProp_Callback *Callback);
int OutdoorPlugIn_ComputePrePro(const WinProp_PreProUrban *ParameterPrePro, const char *OutputFileName, URBAN_BUILDINGS *Buildings, TOPOGRAPHY *Topography, const WinProp_Callback *Callback, const void *ForTheFuture);

tools.name: WinProp_Result_Write / WinProp_Result_Read (API)
tools.description: Result I/O helpers of the WinProp API. They write a computed WinProp_Result to a WinProp result file that ProMan can open, read binary WinProp results and ray files back into API structs, and convert binary results to WinProp ASCII. Related helpers render a result to a bitmap and superpose several transmitters into a total-power result.
